function.name: read_lafina_data
function.description: Reads the student’s schedule/calendar, to-do list, saved notes, or personal memories from local device storage.

kind.description: The type of local student data to read.

query.description: Optional search query, title, or date (YYYY-MM-DD, today, tomorrow).

function.name: prepare_lafina_action
function.description: Prepares a to-do, task, event, time block, reminder, or note review card (creation, completion, edit, or deletion) for student confirmation. Nothing is saved until confirmed.

request.description: The natural language description of the item to prepare.

function.name: save_lafina_memory
function.description: Proposes saving an explicit student memory or preference. Stated clearly in a card; nothing is saved without confirmation.

request.description: The explicit fact or preference the student requested to remember.

function.name: read_calendar
function.description: Reads local student calendar events and tasks within a date window.

function.name: search_notes
function.description: Searches local student notes by title or content.

limit.description: Max number of results to return (1..50).

function.name: read_memories
function.description: Reads saved student memories and personal study preferences from local storage.

query.description: Optional search keyword to match memories.

function.name: prepare_memory
function.description: Proposes saving an explicit student fact or preference. Prepares a card for user confirmation before saving.

text.description: The fact or preference to remember (1..200 chars).

function.name: revise_draft
function.description: Modifies an existing in-progress draft card (e.g. changing date, time, title, or duration) before confirmation.

cardId.description: The stable card ID of the draft to revise.

revision.description: The current revision number of the draft.

instruction.description: The spoken instruction describing what to change.

function.name: confirm_draft
function.description: Confirms and commits the pending draft card to the student database.

cardId.description: The stable card ID of the draft to confirm.

function.name: cancel_draft
function.description: Cancels the pending draft card without modifying the student database.

cardId.description: The stable card ID of the draft to cancel.

revision.description: The current revision number of the draft.

function.name: prepare_multi_action
function.description: Prepares a grouped batch of student actions (tasks, calendar events, reminders) for review and confirmation.

text.description: Grouped spoken instruction or description of actions.

function.name: propose_follow_up_reminder
function.description: Proposes a context-driven follow-up reminder for an event or task with explicit user confirmation.

parentTitle.description: Title of the parent event or task.

minutesBefore.description: Minutes before parent event to trigger reminder.
